description: This bar chart, titled "Factual Errors," compares the number of factual errors made by three different question answering (QA) systems—labeled "NoR QA" (yellow with diagonal grid pattern), "OneR QA" (red with star pattern), and "IRCoT QA" (blue with cross-hatch pattern)—across four distinct datasets: "HotpotQA," "2WikiMQA," "MuSiQue," and "IIRC." The horizontal axis lists these four datasets in order from left to right, while the vertical axis represents the count of factual errors, scaled linearly from 0 to 35 with tick marks at regular intervals of 5. Each dataset is represented by a group of three adjacent bars, one for each QA system, allowing for direct comparison within each group. The specific error counts are labeled above each bar: for "HotpotQA," NoR QA has 15 errors, OneR QA has 10, and IRCoT QA has 5; for "2WikiMQA," NoR QA has 29, OneR QA has 23, and IRCoT QA has 14; for "MuSiQue," NoR QA has 28, OneR QA has 27, and IRCoT QA has 23; and for "IIRC," NoR QA has 15, OneR QA has 14, and IRCoT QA has 11. The bars are not sorted by value; they are presented in the order of the datasets. There are no visual emphases like shading or bolding applied to any specific bars.
